messages:
maria (support): FYI a customer (acct: acme-data) is seeing a large number of 502/504s when calling the hosted text-generation endpoint from us-west since ~09:40 UTC. They sent traces and a stack of failing req IDs. Example: x-request-id=rq_48f2a.

maria (support): top-level symptom: GPT calls that normally succeed are returning 502s and occasional 504s. Errors spike coincident with bursts of auth calls from the customer. They said it started after they rolled a client that retries aggressively.

ingress-bot: Alert: high_5xx_rate on /v1/generate in us-west cluster (threshold breach) :rotating_light:

aj (eng-sre): @maria can you paste a sample request/response pairs and the x-request-id? want to check envoy upstream stats and conn pool.

maria (support): pasted below (redacted keys). trace id rq_48f2a. Response headers from edge: 

HTTP/2 502
content-type: application/json
server: envoy
x-envoy-upstream-service-time: 12
status: 502
body: {"error":"upstream connect error or disconnect/reset before headers"}

maria (support): The customer also shared an auth-service trace that shows spikes in auth latency to ~1.2s and a handful of 5xx while requests happened.

nate (eng-runtime): Can you run the envoy admin /server_info and /stats for that proxy? Looking for upstream_cx_overflow or upstream_rq_5xx. Also need : envoy.cluster.<auth_cluster>.upstream_rq_5xx, upstream_cx_total, and connection pool stats.

elaine (eng-infra): grabbed partial stats from the edge host that handled the trace: 

# filtered envoy stats
envoy.cluster.auth-svc.upstream_rq_5xx: 18
envoy.cluster.gen-models.upstream_rq_5xx: 3
envoy.cluster.auth-svc.upstream_rq_401: 0
envoy.http2.tx_reset: 42
envoy.connection_pool.pooled_connections: 0
envoy.http.conn_pool_exhaust: 7

elaine (eng-infra): also saw lots of HTTP/2 GOAWAYs in the edge logs around same window: "received GOAWAY, last_stream_id=..."

aj (eng-sre): that pattern (auth-svc upstream 5xx + conn_pool_exhaust) -> suggests auth is backing up and client retries are piling up on the h2 pool causing stream resets and 502s from envoy. The auth failures propagate as upstream errors.

aj (eng-sre): Repro plan: (1) run a load test from a staging client that does concurrent requests with retries enabled to mimic the customer's new client. (2) Instrument client to toggle keepalive and connection reuse. (3) Run with auth service scaled down to see auth-induced 5xx/backpressure.

maria (support): Customer gave repro steps: 200 concurrent parallel requests with 3 retries and jitter disabled. They also reported short per-request timeouts which cause immediate retry.

nate (eng-runtime): Quick mitigation options: 
- enable per-route circuit-breaker for auth cluster to cap concurrent requests, returning 429 to callers instead of exhausting h2 pool
- add retry budget and split-retry to avoid retry storms to auth
- add a 50ms client-side jitter recommendation to customer

nate (eng-runtime): For immediate customer relief we can flip a per-route config to lower max_concurrent_streams or increase pool size on edge hosts for that customer route, and add an envoy retry policy that avoids sending full retries to auth (fail fast locally).

elaine (eng-infra): Implemented temporary circuit-breaker on auth-svc cluster in staging and bumped connection pool limits on two us-west edges. Watch grafana queries: env_cluster_auth.upstream_rq_5xx and envoy.http.conn_pool_exhaust.

maria (support): Customer confirmed a drop in 502s after we made the staging tweak and asked if there's a permanent fix. They want an RCA and mitigation plan. :eyes:

aj (eng-sre): Action items: 
- nate: propose a route-level circuit-breaker + retry policy that we can roll to hosted customers (RFC in eng-runtime).
- elaine: run a controlled canary config change to increase pool size + monitor for regressions.
- maria: open SE ticket for acme-data with recommended client changes (reduce retries, add jitter, reuse connections).

nate (eng-runtime): I'll draft the config snippet. basic example: 
```
route: {
  retry_policy: { num_retries: 2, per_try_timeout: 500ms, retry_on: "5xx,connect-failure" }
  upstream_cx_concurrency_limit: 150
  circuit_breakers: { thresholds: [{ max_connections: 1000, max_pending_requests: 200, max_requests: 500 }] }
}
```

nate (eng-runtime): follow-up: add an alert for http2.tx_reset spikes and conn_pool_exhaust so we catch this before customer impact.

maria (support): thanks team — i've scheduled a postmortem with acme-data tomorrow and will include the mitigations. I'll keep thread updated with customer replies.

aj (eng-sre): thumbs up. if acme wants immediate SLA workaround we can also route them to a dedicated edge pool temporarily.

maria (support): last note — saved traces: rq_48f2a, rq_48f9c, rq_48ff0. linking in support ticket.

ingress-bot: Incident note created: INC-2026-0421 (linked to support ticket ST-4592)
